title: NanoForge Manifest
description: Manifest of a NanoForge registry package or editor plugin (nanoforge.manifest.json), at the root of its archive. The registry checks it at publication; other fields are kept as written.

version.description: Semver version, never published before (even if unpublished since)

type.description: package: installed in a project's nf_modules; plugin: an editor plugin. Fixed by the first publication

readme.description: Path of the readme in the archive (default: README.md at the root)

dependencies.description: Registry packages installed with this one, with semver ranges, or a list of names (any version)

libDependencies.description: npm engine libraries and their ranges (not installed by nf install)

npmDependencies.description: Other npm packages and their ranges (not installed by nf install)

engines.description: What runs the package, with semver ranges, e.g. { "editor": ">=0.1.0" }

suggestedPlugins.description: Editor plugins that make the package easier to use

contents.description: What the package holds, whatever its folder layout

kind.description: A core kind (asset, type, enum, file…) or a plugin's kind, prefixed by its name (@nanoforge/ecs:component)

path.description: Relative to the manifest; a folder when it ends with /

^@[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*\\/[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-].description: Data only the named plugin reads

include.description: Sub-manifests: folders (their nanoforge.manifest.json) or .json files, relative to this manifest
